functionalChanges: Only SuperAdmin/SuperAdministrador/SuperUsuario/SuperUser see the historical QUO migration panel.
Migration panel uses lazy-loaded native collapsed details accordion in both account quote and route tabs.
Pricing legacy catalog, candidate search, reconciliation and client name synchronization also enforce superadministrator claims server-side.
Ordinary linked quote history, routes and Pricing indicators remain accessible under existing scopes.
tests: Pricing integration tests for privileged role variants and denial of Admin, Administrador and seller roles.
CRM Vue regression tests for administrator-only lazy accordion.
Preserve universal version checks, build and existing API contracts.
production: No master merge until develop validation and user authorization.
rollback: Coordinated revert of release commits; no data schema change.
